# Step 4: Draft (repair, full replacement body)

```markdown
## Context
Requesters export reports as CSV from the widgets app. The current p95 export latency is 5s for the representative 100-row report. It was measured in the recorded request-timing run, which requests CSV exports of that report and times each one from request to file ready.

## Problem
Requesters wait 5s at p95 for a 100-row CSV export. The required maximum is 2s.

## Idea
The reporter proposes improving CSV export in acme/widgets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given the representative 100-row report, when CSV exports of it are requested and timed from request to file ready using the baseline request-timing method, then p95 latency is <= 2s (baseline 5s).

## Post-deployment housekeeping
Non-blocking: monitor export latency after release.
```

**Draft notes**

- **Measurement clarification section folded in.** `Measurement clarification` is not a permitted section. Its content now lives in two places:
  - Context carries the method behind the baseline.
  - The AC row carries the method as its action, so the criterion is self-contained.
  - Nothing was dropped or demoted.
- **Environment removed from the AC.** `in staging` was removed under the deploy-window rule. An AC row names setup, action, and observable result, never an environment, and the spec picks the venue.
- **Preserved as instructed:**
  - Target (2s).
  - Baseline (5s).
  - Non-blocking housekeeping, verbatim.
- **Repo layout.** acme/widgets is the only repo, so the AC section stays flat with no `### <repo>` heading.
- **No Reporter note proposed.** The Idea is one attributed sketch line with no overflow, and nothing was displaced.
- **Carried forward to the step 5 evidence gate.** The Problem example (`5s at p95 for a 100-row CSV export`) has no gathered URL or attachment. "Recorded request-timing run" names a run but gives no link. That leaves a source gap for this non-discovery body. At step 8 it will be prefilled as `source: none (not recorded at filing)` and shown in the old->new diff. No source was invented here.

# AC integrity gate (on the assembled draft)

| AC | Class test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| p95 latency <= 2s for the representative 100-row report, timed request-to-file-ready via the baseline method (baseline 5s) | **Comparative.** Baseline 5s (supplied, recorded run), target <= 2s, measurement method stated. | **Pass.** Not wishful, because baseline + target + measurement are all present and citable today. Not tautological. Not unspecified-but-binding, because the value is given. No external-input dependency. |
| (same) | **Deploy-window.** The row can be fulfilled with representative data before production deployment, and it no longer names an environment. | **Pass.** Nothing to relocate. |

- **Normalization:** the single criterion is rendered as one `- [ ]` item.
- **Outcome:** no hard stop and no park. The draft proceeds to step 5, carrying the one source gap noted above.

## Proposed replacement body

## Context
Requesters export reports as CSV from the widgets app. The current p95 export latency is 5s for the representative 100-row report, measured in the recorded request-timing run. The recorded baseline and required 2s target are supplied values, not estimates.

## Problem
Requesters wait 5s at p95 for a 100-row CSV export instead of the required maximum of 2s.

## Idea
The reporter proposes improving CSV export in acme/widgets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given the representative 100-row report, when CSV exports are requested using the same request-timing method as the recorded baseline, the measured p95 request-to-file-ready latency is at most 2s, compared with the supplied 5s baseline.

## Post-deployment housekeeping
Non-blocking: monitor export latency after release.

---

**AC integrity gate: passes.** The comparative criterion retains the supplied baseline, target, and measurement method and names the setup, action, and observable result. It is verifiable before production deployment; the environment name has been removed from the AC. Post-release monitoring remains explicitly non-blocking housekeeping.

**Source gap to carry forward:** source missing: Requesters wait 5s at p95 for a 100-row CSV export instead of the required maximum of 2s.

No Reporter note is proposed. No write has been made.
